reason: The research families were selected in August 2026 with knowledge of published and local 2025-2026 market evidence. Therefore 2025-01-01 through 2026-07-31 is parameter-embargoed but not an epistemically blind holdout.
interpretation: Historical confirmation can falsify a frozen rule and quantify recent decay, but cannot establish an unbiased durable-alpha claim because family selection used later knowledge.
Only the prospective forward shadow is genuinely untouched after registration.
No strategy advances to capital deployment from historical confirmation alone.

candidate_groups.mechanical_selection: Among validation-pass members, select the highest 2x-cost validation benchmark-excess Sharpe; count every member's trials. No member passes if the selected excess cumulative return is nonpositive.
Among validation-pass members, select the highest 2x-cost validation benchmark-excess Sharpe after verifying gross/net exposure and benchmark comparability; otherwise select neither.

excluded_from_historical_confirmation: frozen-cross-asset-trend-audit because its historical 2025-2026 metrics are already exposed
crypto-microstructure-execution because it is feasibility/execution research on a bounded sample
event-semantics because current data supports a timing/coverage audit, not a frozen return strategy
mandatory_naive_baselines: unconditional fully funded carry for carry variants
price-only rule for macro and CFTC overlays
underlying and published methodology index for volatility-premium work

historical_confirmation_statistics.test_statistic: annualized mean benchmark-excess return divided by a heteroskedasticity/autocorrelation-consistent standard error; Sharpe and drawdown remain descriptive secondary metrics

multiple_testing.exploratory_discovery: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.10 across every frozen historical-confirmation candidate
multiple_testing.strong_confirmation: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise alpha=0.05 across every frozen historical-confirmation candidate
multiple_testing.rule: Report both corrections and the total frozen-candidate count; do not relabel an FDR-only result as confirmed.

historical_confirmation_statistics.trial_accounting: Deflated Sharpe and PBO use all wave-one variants plus known historical searches where the same strategy family or universe informed selection.

prospective_forward_shadow.minimum_duration: six calendar months and at least 100 independent decisions; twelve months preferred for daily strategies
prospective_forward_shadow.operations: append-only paper signals and modeled fills; parameters, universe, costs, and benchmark remain frozen
prospective_forward_shadow.unblinding: one scheduled read; intermediate observations are operational diagnostics only
